parsed.why: Most-protective tier: shield law for travelling care seekers, GI non-discrimination since 1993, panic defence abolished, X licences. Only dated (2012) custody incident; protective machinery lifts well above parent's 0.35 despite national exposure.

Criminalises trans facility use in government buildings AND private businesses, up to a year jail — universal-exposure, tier-1, steepest such law; visitor always exposed. Suit unresolved; already narrowings. Falls materially below parent's 0.35.

Executive order fixes sex at birth across agencies, endorses single-sex spaces; documented birth-sex cell placement with sexual assault and dismissive court response; no GI hate-crime law. Adds a hostile local layer below parent's 0.35, though criminal exposure is tethered to national rules.

Low-risk group per 2026 assessment; no facility ban, GI non-discrimination and hate-crime enhancement since 2013, medical-provider marker change. Modestly above parent's 0.35; no documented additional exposure, few operating protections documented either.

Strong 2020 statutory protections, panic-defence repeal, X licences, low-risk grouping; but school bathroom/pronoun and sports restrictions, contested teacher speech ruling, and reversal uncertain. Sits just above parent's 0.35, marginally below slot 4.
